layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-sm (2px to 4px max) for a sharp, technical look
layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: The Control Room Grid (dense, functional, 1px borders, rigid hierarchy). Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for dashboard widgets.
layout_and_spacing.component_style: Grid Borders: Containers have 1px solid borders. No heavy drop shadows. Crisp edges.

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Minimalist and snappy. No heavy animations. Focus on clarity.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Subtle background color shifts, slight border color darken, crisp text color changes. Example: hover:bg-slate-100.
motion_and_interactions.focus_states: High-contrast ring. Example: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-1.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-sm), strong contrast. Primary uses Cobalt Blue bg with white text. Secondary uses transparent bg with 1px border.
components.cards: Flat background (white or surface), 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover adds shadow-sm and slightly darkens border.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults but override border-radius to rounded-sm. Focus state must be highly visible.
components.tables: Zebra striping or crisp 1px borders between rows. Dense padding for data visibility.
components.navigation: Left-sidebar for dashboard with clear active states (e.g., left border highlight or strong background tint).

hero_background.description: Abstract geometric architectural design in black and white with futuristic and modern elements.

student_coding.description: Laptop screen displaying code and icons on dock

course_thumbnail_placeholder.description: A laptop showcasing colorful code in a dark environment.

avatar_placeholder.description: A young woman in a classroom with a book.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 ratio. Especially text on primary blue or accent orange.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Outfit for all headings, IBM Plex Sans for body text, and JetBrains Mono for code snippets.
Adopt a 'Control Room' grid layout for dashboards: high density, crisp 1px borders, zero or minimal border-radius (rounded-sm max).
Avoid generic Tailwind shadows (shadow-md/lg). Rely on borders and background color contrasts (White vs #F4F5F7) for depth.
Avoid purple/violet gradients entirely. Use Cobalt Blue (#194BFB) as the primary action color and Code Green (#10B981) for success/approved states.
Do not build a frankendashboard. Ensure progressive disclosure and semantic colors for clarity.
Incorporate the provided unsplash/pexels URLs for placeholders and backgrounds. DO NOT use dummyimage.com or via.placeholder.
